FlatBufferTypeRef.description: Payload-schema identity for a stream frame or an accepted port type.

SCHEMA_VERSION.description: Optional semver or schema revision string.

ROOT_TYPE.description: Optional root type name within the schema.

SCHEMA_HASH.description: Optional schema hash bytes for stronger compatibility checks.

ACCEPTS_ANY_FLATBUFFER.description: True when this port/type set accepts any FlatBuffer frame.

WIRE_FORMAT.description: Logical wire format for this accepted type.

FIXED_STRING_LENGTH.description: Fixed string length for aligned-binary string fields, when applicable.

BYTE_LENGTH.description: Byte length for fixed-size aligned-binary records, when applicable.

REQUIRED_ALIGNMENT.description: Required start alignment for aligned-binary records, when applicable.

TAB.description: Typed Arena Buffer — one descriptor for a payload slot in a shared arena.

OFFSET.description: Byte offset of the payload body within the arena.

SIZE.description: Byte length of the payload body.

ALIGNMENT.description: Required start alignment of the payload body (in bytes).

FRAME_ID.description: Optional opaque frame identifier for stream bookkeeping.

PORT_ID.description:
Optional port identifier for frames that route to/from a named
input or output port on a method (maps to
`PLG.PLGPortManifest.PORT_ID`). Empty for arena frames that carry
no port routing hint.

INPUTS.description:
Input frames. Each TAB.TYPE_REF names the payload schema and each
TAB.WIRE_FORMAT selects FLATBUFFER or ALIGNED_BINARY. TAB.OFFSET
is arena-relative into PAYLOAD_ARENA (or an absolute pointer when
PAYLOAD_ARENA is empty).

PAYLOAD_ARENA.description:
Optional arena backing the INPUTS payload bodies. Empty means the
caller manages arena state out-of-band.

TRACE_ID.description: Optional trace identifier for request correlation.

OUTPUT_STREAM_CAP.description:
Optional yield-budget hint. Plugins MAY pause queued work after
draining this many output frames and return YIELDED for the caller
to resume. 0 = no hint.

STATUS_CODE.description: Method-specific status code. Zero conventionally indicates success.

YIELDED.description: True when the method yielded before fully draining queued work.

BACKLOG_REMAINING.description:
Outstanding frame count remaining after this response. Non-zero
only when STATUS == YIELDED.

OUTPUTS.description: Output frames. Each TAB carries schema identity and wire format.

PAYLOAD_ARENA.description: Optional arena backing OUTPUTS payload bodies.

ERROR_CODE.description: Stable machine-readable error code when STATUS == FAILED.

TRACE_ID.description: Echo of the request's TRACE_ID for correlation.

PIV.description:
Envelope — carries either a request or a response. Either REQUEST or
RESPONSE is populated per message; both populated is undefined.
